# unique

<link-summary>Removes duplicates from an array, keeping the first occurrence of each value.</link-summary>

<web-summary>unique() — Removes duplicates from an array, keeping the first occurrence of each value. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>lang/array</code> · Since: 1.11.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function unique<T, K = T>(array: T[], iteratee?: (value: T) => K): T[];
```

Values are compared with `SameValueZero`, the rule a `Set` uses: `NaN` deduplicates against `NaN`, which `===` never
does, and `-0` collapses with `0`. Order is the order of first appearance, and the input is not modified.

Objects are compared by identity, so two objects with the same contents are two values. The optional `iteratee`
produces the key each value is compared by, which is how records are deduplicated by an id rather than by identity.
When keys collide, the earlier value wins.

## Parameters

| Parameter               | Type              | Description                                                                         |
| :---------------------- | :---------------- | :---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `array`                 | `T[]`             | The array to deduplicate. Left untouched.                                           |
| `iteratee` _(optional)_ | `(value: T) => K` | Produces the key a value is compared by. Values compare by themselves when omitted. |

## Returns

`T[]` — a new array without duplicates, in the order of first appearance.

## Throws

| Exception   | Condition                |
| :---------- | :----------------------- |
| `TypeError` | `array` is not an array. |

## Examples

### Deduplicating values

```javascript
unique([1, 2, 2, 3]); // => [1, 2, 3]
unique(["a", "b", "a"]); // => ["a", "b"]
unique([NaN, NaN]); // => [NaN]
unique([0, -0]); // => [0]
```

### Deduplicating records by a key

```typescript
import { unique } from "apps-script-utils";

const rows = [
  { id: 1, name: "first" },
  { id: 1, name: "second" },
  { id: 2, name: "third" }
];

unique(rows, (row) => row.id); // => [{ id: 1, name: "first" }, { id: 2, name: "third" }]
```

### Collecting the distinct values of a column

<tabs group="code">
<tab title="TypeScript" group-key="ts">
<code-block lang="typescript" src="unique.ts" include-symbol="listStatuses"/>
</tab>
<tab title="JavaScript" group-key="js">
<code-block lang="javascript">
function listStatuses(sheet) {
  const column = sheet.getRange("C2:C").getValues().flat();
  return unique(column.filter((status) => status !== ""));
}
</code-block>
</tab>
</tabs>
